More Exhaust Flow = More Power

PowerNation
Oct 14th, 2026

More Exhaust Flow = More Power

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:30
Instaread

It’s basic science— increasing exhaust flow can free up extra power that’s better used at the rear wheels. That’s what an XForce WORKHORSE Cat-Back Exhaust System can do for your late model GM, Ford, or RAM truck. Made from durable 409 stainless steel, the direct-replacement systems combine 3- or 3.5-inch diameter mandrel-bent tubing with a high-flow, straight-through muffler. That reduces exhaust flow restriction to help your truck’s engine breathe more efficiently— and that frees up some extra power and improves throttle response. The WORKHORSE systems are covered by XForce’s 5-year limited warranty.

Winterize Your Boat for a Trouble-Free Spring

When you put your boat in the water next spring, the last thing you want is trouble due to poor  winterization and storage this fall. You can avoid costly repairs by following some winterization tips from experts at Sierra Marine:

  • Clean and dry your boat top to bottom
  • Purge the cooling system to eliminate salt, dirt, and corrosion
  • Fill the fuel tank and add fuel stabilizer to prevent gum and varnish buildup
  • Spray the cylinders with fogging oil to prevent rust and corrosion
  • Lubricate everything on the boat that can be lubricated

If you need maintenance products or parts to fix stuff, Summit Racing has the Sierra Marine parts to do the job.
